# Deployment Requirements Checklist: Dogfood Deployment

**Purpose**: Validate that local and packaged dogfood deployment requirements are complete, clear, consistent, and ready for implementation planning.
**Created**: 2026-06-21
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are both supported deployment paths explicitly defined with distinct purposes, users, and outcomes? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §User Story 2]
- [ ] CHK002 Are all required local service groups named in requirements or contracts, including infrastructure, backends, workers, identity, proxy, and app entry point? [Completeness, Contract §Local Required Service Groups]
- [ ] CHK003 Are packaged deployment deliverables fully enumerated, including compose file, environment example, build command, docs, and image targets? [Completeness, Contract §Packaged Required Files]
- [ ] CHK004 Are shutdown and reset requirements separately specified for both local and packaged paths? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK005 Are reusable and disposable runtime state requirements documented for both `.data/` and packaged persistent volumes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Plan §Technical Context]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is "single documented local dogfood startup command" defined clearly enough to exclude a required prior `start-infra` step? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, Contract §Local Commands]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "service status and log workflow" defined with enough detail to distinguish health, starting, failed, and stopped states? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "public entry point" specified consistently enough for local and packaged deployment documentation to identify the same user-facing access path? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, Contract §Packaged Compose Service Contract]
- [ ] CHK009 Are "safe defaults" and "must be changed before sharing" distinguishable for every required configuration value? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Contract §Environment Contract]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "known differences" defined with concrete categories so participants can separate intentional local behavior from packaged deployment defects? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 Do the spec and local process-compose contract agree that `start-infra` remains a debugging path rather than the default dogfood startup path? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, Contract §start-infra]
- [ ] CHK012 Do the plan and packaged deployment contract agree on split-service packaging rather than an all-in-one default? [Consistency, Plan §Summary, Contract §Packaged Scope]
- [ ] CHK013 Are service exposure requirements consistent between the spec, plan, and packaged compose contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, Plan §Constraints, Contract §Compose Service Contract]
- [ ] CHK014 Are state and secret hygiene requirements consistent with the constitution's `.data/`, volume, and placeholder-secret rules? [Consistency, Constitution §Runtime State and Secret Hygiene, Spec §FR-007, Spec §FR-009]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK015 Are startup time outcomes measurable for both local and packaged workflows without relying on implementation-specific internals? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-001, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the "90% of routine local dogfood startup attempts" target defined with an observable denominator and collection context? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the dogfooding report quality target measurable from submitted reports without requiring subjective interpretation? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK018 Are smoke-test success criteria specific enough to prove storage, metadata, and movement coverage while preserving implementation flexibility? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-004]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK019 Are primary, alternate, exception, and recovery scenarios covered for local startup, packaged startup, status inspection, shutdown, and reset? [Coverage, Spec §Acceptance Scenarios, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK020 Are interrupted startup and post-start service-exit scenarios specified as requirements rather than only listed as edge cases? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK021 Are stale image and missing image scenarios covered in packaged deployment requirements with expected documentation outcomes? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Contract §Operations Contract]
- [ ] CHK022 Are duplicate event, retry, and restarted-service requirements clear enough to protect existing file-event behavior during dogfood smoke tests? [Coverage, Spec §Contracts & Integration Impact]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK023 Are port conflict and local service-name conflict requirements defined with expected diagnostic information? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK024 Are missing, weak, or local-only secret scenarios addressed in both configuration requirements and failure-reporting guidance? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK025 Are requirements defined for cleanup-only use cases where participants need shutdown or reset without restart? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK026 Are sensitive-log handling requirements specific enough to prevent credentials, tokens, or secrets from entering dogfood reports? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Contract §Reporting Contract]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK027 Are reproducibility requirements tied to Nix shells, Nix-built images, and documented commands without leaving host-state assumptions implicit? [Non-Functional, Plan §Constitution Check]
- [ ] CHK028 Are privacy and exposure requirements specified for internal infrastructure services in packaged deployment? [Security, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK029 Are operational observability requirements defined for logs, health, status, and failure diagnostics across both deployment paths? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK030 Are scope limits clear that packaged Compose is for single-host dogfooding and not a production horizontal-scaling guarantee? [Scope, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Scale/Scope]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK031 Are prerequisite assumptions documented for Nix, submodules, container runtime, and prepared workstation state? [Assumption, Quickstart §Prerequisites]
- [ ] CHK032 Are component-boundary assumptions explicit enough to identify when a change belongs in root versus `reliquary/`, `engram/`, or `synapse/`? [Assumption, Plan §Project Structure]
- [ ] CHK033 Are existing application API, event, queue, and storage contracts explicitly preserved unless a later plan scopes a change? [Dependency, Spec §Contracts & Integration Impact, Research §No Application Contract Changes]
- [ ] CHK034 Are external dependency expectations for Docker or Podman Compose documented without making one runtime accidentally mandatory? [Dependency, Contract §Packaged Scope, Quickstart §Prerequisites]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK035 Is "primary app entry point" defined precisely enough to avoid conflict between desktop app, web app, and ingress-based packaged access? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK036 Is "movement or reconciliation behavior where present" clarified enough to decide when Synapse is mandatory in a smoke test versus optional? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-008, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK037 Is the image naming contract aligned with the plan's packaging scope, or does it leave ambiguity about reused Reliquary images versus root Mind Palace images? [Ambiguity, Contract §Image Contract, Plan §Project Structure]
- [ ] CHK038 Are acceptance scenarios traceable to functional requirements and success criteria with enough IDs or section references for future task generation? [Traceability, Spec §Acceptance Scenarios, Spec §Functional Requirements, Spec §Success Criteria]
